_comment: Guilty Conscience on an attacker, design step 5: combat damage is 'deals damage', so the combat hook
(dmgrx::CombatDamageDealt, armed decks only) raises GC. Screaming Nemesis (3/3 haste) connects for 3;
GC deals 3 back; Nemesis dies (GC to the graveyard with it) and its last-known reflection deals 3 to
the face: 6 = the opponent's life. The host is SEARCHED: Mogg Maniac (first on the battlefield) is
the other legal host, and GC there gives 1 + 1 + Nemesis's 3 = 5. (Design 10 wrote '3 + 3 + 3' for
this case; the third 3 cannot happen -- GC leaves with its host, design 2.4.)
